title: The Transmission, wanted — a declared absence: Moraux, Düring, Pfeiffer, Wehrli and the modern editions of the lists, lives and fragments, with the public-domain witnesses no usable copy was found for
edition: No edition held. The seat holds the declaration of what it would hold: declared/absence.json and declared/absence.md.

why_seated: The editions and studies of the Peripatetic transmission the thirty-first seating could not hold, declared beside the texts it holds (31/01–31/10), at the author's direction to gather and seat the debts of the study Legitimately Many (2026-11-01). Twelve are still in their United States term and open on the dates given; four are open now and wanted because no usable copy was found this session. The modern editions are where the twentieth century numbered the lists and fragments the seated texts carry, so each entry names what the study cites from it.
ruling: Lee Sharks, 2026-11-01, of the texts named in §5 of the design Legitimately Many: "lets gather and seat those. with an ea-corpora".
